topology.p2p: localhost bootnode with the official seven-node private-network genesis

observations: Reth maintained seven protocol peers and followed the six-Geth validator chain through a restart.

The full DKG epoch gate advanced round 5 to round 6, checked every block in the height window, matched the aggregate commitment on all seven clients, and confirmed two Reth prover/submission attempts with zero preparation, receipt, or expiry failures.
The committed tools/neox-dkg-prover helper passed its Go test suite and build; the private-network ZK-v0 run used the same protocol boundary with local testnet artifacts.
The private genesis has no transaction-bearing blocks in the sampled window, so receipt-level execution comparison was exercised but checked zero transactions.
Prover-delay, transaction replacement, explicit view-change, Anti-MEV envelope decryption, and controlled reorg gates still require dedicated fault-injection scenarios.
